statement_summary: Annual risk assessment and targeted risk analyses
PCI DSS scope documented and confirmed every 12 months; SAQ answers backed by evidence
Sanctions for policy violations
Background checks before access to card data or guest records
Service provider list, agreements, and annual AOC or SOC 2 check
Privacy, fee, and rate statements reviewed for accuracy
Unique accounts; no shared front desk or night audit logins
Least privilege; full card number display limited to named users
MFA for PMS, email, cloud, and all remote access
Same-day access removal at termination
Vendor default passwords changed; system credentials managed
Vendor remote access on request only, with MFA and logging
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Acquirer and card brand notice; preserve evidence
Breach notice decisions and deadlines
Annual incident response test
Card data only in approved payment services
No card security codes stored
Card forms replaced by payment links; interim handling
Retention schedule (guest register 2 years; ID scans 30 days)
Isolated immutable backups tested quarterly
Annual training; monthly reminders; phishing exercises
Shift inspections of payment devices
Approved AI tools only; controlled changes to pricing and chatbot
